task.title: Separate privileged task intake from genuine MFA-bound execution authorization

revision_history.note: Prior owner commit explicitly left P1-1/2/3/8 and P2 open.
Canonical generation 6 assignment supersedes original plan assignment; no independent approval claimed by implementation helpers.

changes: Full verified signed task_spec hash and work_class are part of immutable policy digest. Current contract, assignment, generation and target are checked before submission, reserve and entry; reopen/reassignment preserve policy and restore pending hold.

Verified MFA issuer public-key fingerprint binds nonce replay identity, so unsigned key aliases cannot reuse the same assertion. Public source signing trust and MFA issuer trust remain separate; absent genuine issuer stays closed.

Authoritative spend reloads regardless of a stale queue snapshot and binds exactly one event attempt. Reservation is rechecked under the canonical read lock through adapter launch; crash/replay never replenishes the grant.

Existing worker/phase launch receipt binds Linux PID/start ticks, run/queue, command, task/generation/role, workspace, command runtime and authoritative journal identity. Entry and heartbeat read the journal without mirror fallback. Legacy absent generation follows canonical generation 1.

Worker final Popen repeats authorization under canonical shared lock. Revocation requests termination at existing heartbeat boundary (maximum 15 seconds) then bounded five-second SIGTERM grace; no rollback completion is asserted.

Privileged review/finalization does not consume a grant and uses a read-only task worktree. Existing sandbox now explicitly seals command runtime and canonical workspace source roots after the broad temporary-directory mount.

Runtime promotion/discover-only executes the chosen candidate interpreter in isolation, proves both intake/execution behavior, verifies actual runner entry and guard wiring, and records candidate module paths/hashes. Unsafe older candidates fail closed.

Approved SA/SD is byte-identical to immutable source including trailing blank line. Operational commands live in current runbook; first-release entrypoint and supplemental manifest distinguish source, runtime and hosted gates.
remaining_coordinator_acceptance: Assigned reviewer independently reviews the frozen exact PR head and this manifest; existing canonical integrator merges after approval/checks.

Coordinator uses existing qualified runtime discover-only preflight/promotion with explicit current roots, selected Python, public verifier binding and preserved workers/leases. Record actual live both-barrier/no-MFA-no-launch evidence; source merge alone is insufficient.

Only after accepted source and qualified runtime, deduplicate and submit the three original unsigned hosted tasks through signed bridge as pending authorization; update only obsolete MFA-at-intake wording in the not-yet-signed source draft.

hosted_intake.required_preservation: original IDs, hosted class, pantheon-dev resource, full acceptance/artifacts/dependencies; STRUCT remains sole product source join

not_claimed: genuine MFA proof or live grant
FE/BFF exact-pair deployment or rollback success
test_boundary: All synthetic principals, keys, TaskStores, runtime receipts and subprocess effects are isolated local fixtures. They are not live credentials, operator evidence or hosted proof.
prior_failed_batches: Earlier partial repair evidence labelled some nonzero test runs as pass. This revision replaces those claims with terminal clean-head batch results; intermediate failed runs remain failure diagnostics, never accepted verification.
